description: Search existing reviewed evidence questions and fixed-pack topics when you do not know a route ID. Use this for governance, tool permissions, audit/export and evidence-boundary questions. For a known software advisory ID or an exact ecosystem/package lookup, use find_package_advisories instead. Supply query as keywords (maximum 160 characters), or leave it blank to browse. offset is the zero-based pagination offset (default 0, maximum 10000; increase by 20). Returns up to 20 matches with route_id, matched wording and the scoped question; pass a route_id to preview_evidence_answer for the complete free answer and sources. Matching ignores case, punctuation and common question words; it does not validate arbitrary new claims. No match is not a negative verdict. Free and read-only.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, 0 to 10000; start at 0 and increase by 20 for the next page.

query.description: Keywords for an existing reviewed question or evidence-pack topic; leave blank to browse the first 20 routes.

name: find_evidence_questions
title: Find published evidence questions
